item.title: Support
item.description: Convientent assisstance Lazursoft isn’t above fixing hardware or software problems. We have solved issues in everywhere from data centers and offices to active retail spaces. Support services provided by Lazursoft include: General assistance: When everything that usually works by itself stops working, we thrive in making it work again. Example cases: Guest devices can’t connect to the customer’s wireless network. Fixing a used printer that doesn’t work. Remote: 15,000 won; in-person 30,000 won for 1 hour of work Industry assistance: For the larger more time consuming cases.

item.title: Operations
item.description: Operational assisstance Services are continuously in movement, they don’t always move by themselves. Anything from a mission critical cloud service disconnecting to a printer malfunction can be a costly problem. Available in in person(Norther Seoul area), or remotely. All prices displayed are estimates and subject to change. Support services provided by Lazursoft include: Maintaining physical devices (northern Seoul/Uijeongbu only): Troubleshoot or configure devices 30,000 won fee, 20,000 won an hour of work.
